component.name: Anvil IDE
component.summary: Fast, lightweight C++ IDE with a native core

description.p: Anvil is a C++-first integrated development environment with clangd-powered intelligence, a native C++ core, and a Monaco editor inside the system WebKitGTK view.

Filesystem access is scoped to the open workspace. Language servers run in a bubblewrap sandbox with seccomp, without network access and with a read-only workspace. Anvil has no telemetry and loads no remote content.
This 0.0.1 release is experimental. Build integration, debugging, an integrated terminal, Git write operations, plugins, and AI are scheduled for later phases.
Initial experimental release with clangd hover, completion, navigation, and diagnostics.
